# Blake Zuniga (Blake Z)

> Blake Zuniga, also known as Blake Z, is a blues folk guitarist and songwriter. https://blakezuniga.com/ is the official website for Blake Z Music and Zuniga Music. He is a former member of The Curl Tapes and is now working on Zuniga Volume One.

## Facts

- Name: Blake Zuniga, also known as Blake Z. His music project is Blake Z, also called Blake Z Music, Zuniga or Zuniga Music.
- Music: folk blues (blues folk) guitar and songwriting; the site is built around the Blake Zuniga guitar sound.
- Band history: Blake is a former member of The Curl Tapes. The band's own page about him is https://thecurltapes.com/aboutpage/blakezuniga/.
- Now: working on Zuniga Volume One.
- The homepage is an interactive 3D guitar scene. It also holds the Vinyl Vault, Blake Zuniga's record collection of 113 albums.
